notes: HOW ke0 AND tPeak ARE DERIVED (R/getDrugPK.R, R/metaboliteCoefficients.R).  `solve` names the case. ke0FromTPeak (propofol, remifentanil, sufentanil: the drug function gives tPeak): ke0FromTPeakBolus(tPeak, p, lambda), where p = p_coef_bolus and peakAt(z) = effectSitePeakTime(p, lambda, z).  Bracket: lo = 1e-3, hi = 1; while peakAt(lo) < tPeak and lo > KE0_SOLVE_MIN (1e-12) lo = lo / 10; while peakAt(hi) > tPeak and hi < KE0_SOLVE_MAX (1e6) hi = hi * 10; if peakAt(lo) < tPeak return lo; if peakAt(hi) > tPeak return hi; else stats::uniroot(function(z) peakAt(z) - tPeak, c(lo, hi), tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)$root (R_zeroin2 in R's src/library/stats/src/zeroin.c, maxiter 1000, f(lo) and f(hi) evaluated first).  `bracket` records lo, hi and peakAt there; `ke0BeforeSeparation` is that root.  tPeakFromKe0 (remimazolam: the drug function gives ke0 = exp(-1.20976) and no tPeak): ke0 is the model's (`modelKe0`) and tPeak = effectSitePeakTime(p, lambda, ke0) (`tPeakResolved`). Both: ke0 <- separateEigenvalues(ke0, lambda) (a relative 1 + 1e-8 nudge only if |ke0 - lambda_i| < 1e-10 max(ke0, lambda_i); never fires here), which is `ke0`. effectSitePeakTime(coef, lambda, ke0, upper = 4000): use = lambda > 0; ke0 = separateEigenvalues(ke0, lambda[use]); e = coef * ke0 / (ke0 - lambda) (note the order: (coef * ke0) / (ke0 - lambda), unlike getDrugPK()'s p / (ke0 - l) * ke0); upper = min(upper, 20 / min(c(lambda, ke0))); stats::optimize(function(t) sum(e * exp(-lambda * t)) - sum(e) * exp(-ke0 * t), c(0, upper), maximum = TRUE)$maximum, i.e. Brent_fmin on the negated function over [0, upper] with the default tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.25.  R's sum() accumulates in long double.  `roundTrip.window` is that upper, `roundTrip.peakTime` the peak at `ke0`, `ceAtPeak` the unit-bolus Ce there; `peakSamples` give effectSitePeakTime() at ke0 x {0.5, 0.8, 0.95, 1, 1.05, 1.25, 2} so a port can check it directly.  `ke0Exact` is the ke0 whose exact peak time (uniroot on dCe/dt, tol 1e-14) equals tPeak; `ke0ExactRelativeDifference` shows how far the library's is from it. This replaced the nested optimize() of tPeakError() on 2026-10-17 (stanpumpR f5b2f0f, 'exact IV ke0 solve').
